Frequently Asked Questions

How far in advance should I book?

Weddings: 6-12 months recommended
Corporate: 2-3 months
Clubs/Private: 1-4 weeks

Do you travel outside South Florida?

Yes, throughout Florida and destination events. Travel fees apply for extended/destination bookings.

What's your cancellation policy?

Deposit is non-refundable. Full fee due 30 days prior. Force majeure clauses in contract for emergencies.

Can I provide a do-not-play list?

Absolutely. We'll review it together during planning. Your vibe, your rules.

Do you take requests during the event?

Yes, within the vibe/genre we agree on. Crowd-reading and requests are part of the art.

Do you provide sound equipment?

Standard rider: CDJs + mixer. Sound system by venue or rented separately. Self-contained rig available for up to 300 pax.

Can you MC / make announcements?

Yes, professional MC services included for weddings and private events. Corporate hosting available.

What payment methods do you accept?

Venmo, Zelle, Check, Wire. Corporate: Net-30 invoicing available with PO.
